challenges.title: Room is not clean
challenges.shortDescription: Handle a guest situation involving room is not clean through a natural workplace conversation.
challenges.mission: Handle the room is not clean situation professionally, understand the guest's need, and move toward a realistic resolution without exceeding staff authority.

guestProfile.emotionalState: Their emotion is driven by the situation and should change in response to the learner's behaviour.
guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: a clean room and a credible next step

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.resistance: low; answers relevant questions and considers reasonable options
level1.guestBehaviour: Clearly states the issue, answers focused questions, and considers a reasonable solution.
hiddenObjectives: Identify the specific cleanliness failures and room areas affected.
Check whether the request has already been reported and what the guest needs most urgently.
Coordinate housekeeping or verify an authorised room alternative.
Set a truthful expectation and confirm the guest accepts the next step.
possibleSolutions: Request the relevant housekeeping action and verify its availability/time.
If appropriate and authorised, check an available alternative room rather than promising a move.
Escalate if the problem remains unresolved or requires approval.

CUSTOMER_UNHAPPY: the limitation remains, but the learner handled it honestly and professionally.

curveballs: The guest says they do not want to repeat the full complaint to multiple staff members.
The guest needs an immediate practical action while the manager is being contacted.
level3.successCondition: Capture the essential complaint, arrange appropriate escalation, and help the guest with any immediate authorised next step. The learner should also communicate clearly, remain professional, and reach a clear accepted next step without exceeding authority.
level3.failureCondition: The learner fails to establish the relevant facts, gives misleading or unsupported information, makes an unauthorised promise, behaves unprofessionally, ignores a material safety/service concern, or reaches the round limit without meaningful progress toward the resolution target.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: The guest is demanding to speak with a manager about a hotel service problem.
knownFacts: The guest wants senior attention.
There is an underlying complaint that should still be understood.
factsToDiscover: the core complaint
what has already been attempted
whether there is an immediate safety/service issue
what the guest needs while the manager is contacted
authorityBoundary: Staff can document the complaint and contact an authorised manager.
Staff should not promise what the manager will decide.
scenarioContext.resolutionTarget: Capture the essential complaint, arrange appropriate escalation, and help the guest with any immediate authorised next step.
